data.rationale: The proposal follows the same core procedure (open Special Events, pick the event, set the ticket count, choose the tier, Reserve Now), but it doesn't include selecting the city or the date as parameters, and it names the event and tier as vague parameters, so an automation would have to guess some inputs.
